whoItsFor: Developers using AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or Gemini CLI who want to query a codebase's structure and related docs as a knowledge graph instead of grepping files. Also useful for teams mapping large or multi-format projects.
useCases: Ask questions about a codebase by querying a graph instead of re-reading files
Trace how two concepts or components connect, such as the shortest path between them
Map docs, PDFs, and images alongside source code into one navigable graph
